about: An experienced professional working at the intersection of project management, artificial intelligence, and information technology. I hold the CAPM® certification from PMI and currently serve as a Professional AI, Data Science, and Project Management Instructor at Inixindo Jogja.

Alongside teaching, I work as an IT Consultant on Data Management and SPBE (National Digital Government Architecture) projects — translating regulation and framework theory into documentation that public sector institutions can actually operate.
Open to conversations about data challenges, governance assessments, or a career switch into Data Science.
